stemMd: A warning is issued if pressure exceeds the limit. No warning was issued. Assuming the rule was followed, what follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Pressure did not exceed the limit.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Pressure exceeded the limit but the rule was followed.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every warning is caused only by pressure.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Pressure must have been exactly zero.

explanationMd: The implication is excess pressure → warning. With no warning and compliance assumed, contraposition gives no excess pressure. The exact pressure and other possible warning causes remain unspecified.

distractorRationale.d: Not exceeding a limit does not specify zero.
distractorRationale.e: No information about gauge presence is given.
distractorRationale.c: The rule gives a sufficient cause, not the only cause.
